content.user_title: Connect Neon Postgres with Drizzle ORM
content.value_statement: Database setup can be difficult when connection, schema, and migration steps are unclear. This skill provides a focused reference for Neon Postgres and Drizzle ORM workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains the Neon serverless Postgres and Drizzle ORM stack.
Shows a DATABASE_URL-based Neon driver connection example.
Identifies the expected database connection and schema file locations.
Lists the documented authentication and application table groups.
Provides select and insert query examples using Drizzle ORM.
Documents Drizzle Kit generation and push migration commands.
limitations: It does not create database files or execute migrations automatically.
It does not provide schema definitions beyond the listed table names.
It does not validate database credentials or network connectivity.
It does not cover query authorization, backups, or production monitoring.

use_cases.title: Set up a Neon connection
use_cases.description: Review the documented driver and environment-variable pattern before configuring a TypeScript service.

use_cases.title: Review a Drizzle data layer
use_cases.description: Use the file layout and query examples to compare an existing project with the expected ORM structure.

use_cases.title: Prepare database migrations
use_cases.description: Identify the documented Drizzle Kit commands for generating and applying schema changes.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the stack
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the Neon Postgres and Drizzle ORM stack described by this skill in simple steps.

prompt_templates.title: Configure a connection
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how the skill connects Drizzle ORM to Neon using DATABASE_URL, and explain each imported package.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a schema update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a safe workflow for changing a Drizzle schema and preparing a migration.

prompt_templates.title: Review database operations
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my proposed Drizzle select and insert operations with the patterns documented in this skill. Identify missing validation or authorization concerns.

output_examples.input: How does this skill connect to Neon?
output: It uses the Neon serverless driver.
It reads DATABASE_URL to create a SQL client.
It passes that client to Drizzle ORM.
Apply changes with the documented push command or a project migration script.
Review generated changes before applying them to a production database.

best_practices: Store DATABASE_URL in the deployment environment and never commit it to source control.
Review generated migrations before applying them to shared or production databases.
Add authorization and input validation around application queries.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode database credentials in source files or prompts.
Do not apply schema pushes to production without review and backups.
Do not treat the example queries as complete authorization controls.

faq.question: Which database does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers Neon, a serverless Postgres database.

faq.question: Which ORM does it use?
faq.answer: It uses Drizzle ORM with the Neon HTTP driver.

faq.question: Where does the connection string come from?
faq.answer: The example reads DATABASE_URL from the runtime environment.

faq.question: Does the skill run migrations automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents Drizzle Kit commands but does not execute them.

faq.question: What queries are included?
faq.answer: It includes simple select and insert examples.

faq.question: Does it secure application data access?
faq.answer: No. You must add authorization, validation, and operational safeguards in your application.
